name: Finger Millet (Ragi)
methodDescription: Dried on mud floors. Beaten until the grain separates. What remains is swept clean.
specimenCopy: Ragi grows on the dry side of Attappady where the rain stops early. The Irula plant it because the hill lets them — it's one of the few things that finishes a season in soil that most crops would leave early.

sensoryProfile.flavor: Deep, slightly malty, with a robust earthy backbone
